notes: Looking up the sets of a track is fast again: one search per site (MixesDB 7 sets for See You Again in about 4 s, it used to time out on a slow link); 1001Tracklists searches with the whole credit and the title and accepts the site's own spelling of the credit. Covers: a download keeps the picture of the page it came from (SoundCloud artwork, YouTube thumbnail) and uses it, cropped square, when MusicBrainz has no cover; Ogg Opus (YouTube audio) can now carry a cover at all. The background cover job counts every track of a short list instead of looking stuck at 1 / 10.
